implementationNotes: This contract defines the first creation scope; the Agent and generic assembly are later steps.
Existing DawnGardenGame expects one Water and one Chest; optional interactions on new plots require later runtime generalization.

Existing expansion runtime supports one small fixed east-side extension. The confirmed new starter-sized plots require later geometry, placement, navigation and save changes; current samples validate shared movement/interaction rules only.
Current NavMesh climb/slope are more permissive than CharacterController. New terrain must obey maxAuthoredStep/maxAuthoredSlope until the bake profile is aligned.
